purpose: Teach: パワフル/備わっ/チョイス/分量/健闘/切り離し/編著/有数

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、パワフルな防犯活動を展開されますね
lines.en: The police really do conduct powerful crime prevention activities, don't they.
lines.style: Mild, observational tone. Respectful acknowledgment without excessive praise. Steady, conversational pace. The slight lift at the end is genuine curiosity, not flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新任警官に実力が備わってきますね
lines.en: The new officers are developing real capability, it seems.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Slower pace on 「実力」—genuine respect. Measured, collegial tone. No edge of competition. The trailing particle softens it from statement to shared observation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査のチョイスを慎重にされますね
lines.en: The investigative decisions are made with real care, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly deliberate delivery. Careful emphasis on the carefulness itself—not rushed. Quiet approval underneath. Measured cadence, as if reflecting on something noticed and respected.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収薬物の分量を測定されますね
lines.en: The seized narcotics are measured and documented precisely.
lines.style: Professional but not cold. Slight nod of approval in the tone. Matter-of-fact pace with understated recognition of the detail-work involved. Competent, assured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警官の健闘を期待されてますね
lines.en: There's real hope in the younger officers' efforts, isn't there.
lines.style: Encouraging, with genuine warmth. Moderate pace. Open quality—like he's noticing something good and letting it show. Not condescending. The particle suggests shared investment in their success.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、関係のない情報を捜査から切り離しを進めますね
lines.en: The way irrelevant details are filtered out of investigations is impressive.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured delivery. Recognition of discipline and thoroughness. Calm respect. No urgency—just steady acknowledgment of a job done right. Slight trailing thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察史の編著にも携わられますね
lines.en: It's notable that you've contributed to police history documentation as well.
lines.style: Surprised respect—he's revealing something he's learned about them. Quieter than before, more sincere. No performance. Direct eye contact implied. Genuine interest in the depth of their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、業界有数の鑑識力をお持ちですね
lines.en: Your forensic expertise is genuinely among the best in the field.
lines.style: Direct, sincere. Finally allowing the full respect to surface. Warm but not overstated. Clear, steady tone. Not overdone—just honest recognition of skill earned and proven. The shift from observational to direct.
